_meta.description: Listen for Firestore changes on jobs/{jobId}/notes/{noteId}. When stage changes to Interviewing, Offer Out, or Filled, send appropriate WhatsApp template. Single workflow handles 3 templates via branching.
_meta.deployment: Import + activate. Requires Firestore field 'stage' on note document; fetches candidate phone from candidates/{candidateId}.

nodes.name: On Note Stage Change
nodes._setupNote: Configure to listen on collection group 'notes' if your Firestore SDK supports it. Otherwise use a Firestore Cloud Function to push to webhook.
